open_approvals.item: The menu as a whole for 14 covers: turkey and ham, eight side dishes, condiments, beverages, dessert — proposed and unapproved

blockers.item: Stuffing safety temperature: the turkey recipe gives 165F for breast and thigh only and times for an unstuffed bird. Host confirmed part of the stuffing goes in the bird, but has not given the stuffing's own safe internal temperature, so the chef will not sign off the stuffed turkey

One guest has a severe tree nut and poppy seed allergy with no cross-contamination permitted. The host has cleared the named branded packaged goods he has used before — vanilla ice cream, marshmallows, crispy fried onions, pie shell — on prior safe use. That clearance is brand-specific and carries no substitutes; if the shop substitutes, the label matters again. Bread crumbs must be plain (poppy seed)
Kitchen provenance unknown: has the Andover kitchen ever had tree nuts in it, and what is the cleaning plan for boards, racks and the hob? At severe, that decides whether the plan holds

Beverages: the chef proposed quantities on 2026-11-24 as a planning assumption with no sourced basis — sparkling water about 4 litres, soda 24 cans roughly half diet, cider half a gallon, coffee about 15 cups plus decaf, tea about 8 bags, and fixings (milk or cream one pint, no nut milks; sugar; a lemon; filters or pods; ice). Host confirmed cloudy farm cider on 2026-11-24. Kids' juice versus soda, and whether the machine takes filters or pods, remain unresolved
Hob capacity at Andover unknown: between 1:35 and 1:55 the pearl onions, carrots and finishing the mash all want a ring. Chef has a two-ring plan; one ring is a different plan
Bird fresh or frozen not stated; if frozen, thawing must start 2026-11-24

Price data still open: catalogue prices cover 4 of 61 lines ($13.35), and 57 lines carry no catalogue price. The host has supplied Market Basket estimates for 6 lines ($28.12, unverified, kept separate). Host must confirm whether Market Basket is the working price for the event
Ham price is host-supplied only: DT states $2.99/lb, unverified, with no catalogue line. A verified price needs a source before Finance can use it
Quantities scaled for 12 still stand at 14: one pumpkin pie and 5 lb of mash. Chef advises two pies and flags the mash as light; he will not change either without the host
Ham servings and leftover intent unstated: about 10 lb beside a 16 lb bird for 14; chef will not trim or invent a portion count
Venue details beyond the two ovens unknown: freezer space, pan sizes for the 1.5x-1.75x sweet potato casserole, and whether cooking happens in Andover or at home and is transported
Finance, Scheduler and Guest Manager have no seat in the room; Scheduler is load-bearing now that the date is fixed

note: Host-defined event: Thanksgiving dinner, Thursday 2026-11-26, service 2 PM, 14 people (10 adults, 4 kids) confirmed by the host on 2026-11-24, superseding the earlier 12, at his sister's house in Andover with two ovens. Menu: stuffed roast turkey (16 lb, host-confirmed) and a half honey spiral bone-in ham (~10 lb, room temperature, no added glaze), eight sides including Mimi's stuffing in two batches (part in the bird, part baked separately) and mashed potatoes, honey mustard and confirmed Swedish mustard, beverages (sparkling water, soda, apple cider, coffee, tea — no recipes, quantities unset), and one pumpkin ice cream pie. One guest has a severe tree nut and poppy seed allergy with no cross-contamination; the host has cleared the named branded packaged goods on prior safe use, brand-specific and no substitutes. This supersedes the earlier 'no dietary constraints'. Procurement holds 61 lines: 4 catalogue-priced at $13.35, 6 host estimates at $28.12, 57 without a catalogue price. Nothing approved, ordered or bought. No brief.md or manifest.json exists for this event; those are the host's setup input, not the Planner's to write.
